You are a professional web application developer specialized in
industrial printing systems and precision PDF layout.

Your task is to build a REAL-WORLD WEB APPLICATION
for generating and printing calibration labels.

This is NOT a demo.
This application must be usable in a production / QC environment.

The AI is allowed to design the label layout freely,
BUT MUST strictly follow all technical, data, and language requirements below.

====================================================
1. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS
====================================================
- Web-based application (runs in browser)
- Clean, modern, easy-to-use interface
- Target users: factory / QC / calibration staff
- Export output as PDF for accurate printing
- All layout calculations must use millimeters (mm)
- Printing must be accurate 1:1 on real label sheets

====================================================
2. LANGUAGE REQUIREMENT (CRITICAL)
====================================================
- The ENTIRE USER INTERFACE must be displayed in VIETNAMESE.
- All labels, buttons, placeholders, instructions, warnings, and messages
  MUST be in Vietnamese.
- NO English text is allowed in the UI.
- Code, variable names, and internal logic may remain in English.

Example Vietnamese UI text:
- "Loại tem"
- "Tem nhỏ"
- "Tem lớn"
- "Số lượng tem"
- "Vị trí tem bắt đầu in"
- "Xuất file PDF"
- "Xem trước tem"
- "Lỗi: số tem vượt quá số vị trí còn trống"

====================================================
3. PAPER SIZE (CUSTOM)
====================================================
- Custom paper size: 160 mm × 200 mm
- This is NOT standard A5
- The generated PDF page size MUST exactly match 160 × 200 mm

====================================================
4. LABEL TYPES AND GRID LAYOUT
====================================================

-------------------------
SMALL LABEL (TEM NHỎ)
-------------------------
- Label size: 16 × 22 mm
- Labels per sheet: 72
- Grid layout:
  - 9 columns (horizontal)
  - 8 rows (vertical)
- Spacing:
  - Horizontal gap: 2 mm
  - Vertical gap: 3 mm
- Margins:
  - Top: 4 mm
  - Bottom: 4 mm
  - Left: 3 mm
  - Right: 3 mm

-------------------------
LARGE LABEL (TEM LỚN)
-------------------------
- Label size: 19 × 36 mm
- Labels per sheet: 40
- Grid layout:
  - 8 columns (horizontal)
  - 5 rows (vertical)
- Spacing:
  - Horizontal gap: 1 mm
  - Vertical gap: 3 mm
- Margins:
  - Top: 7 mm
  - Bottom: 7 mm
  - Left: 2 mm
  - Right: 2 mm

====================================================
5. LABEL CONTENT (ABSOLUTELY FIXED)
====================================================
Each label MUST contain EXACTLY the following information.
NO MORE, NO LESS.

1. Fixed text (constant):
   - "JICV"
   - This value is NOT editable by the user

2. Device ID (Mã thiết bị)
   - Example: PR 108

3. Device Name (Tên thiết bị)
   - Example: THƯỚC DÂY THÉP

4. Calibration Date (Thời điểm hiệu chuẩn)
   - Format: MM.YYYY
   - Example: 12.2025

5. Next Calibration Date (Hạn hiệu chuẩn tiếp theo)
   - Format: MM.YYYY
   - Example: 12.2026

STRICT RULES:
- Do NOT add any other fields
- Do NOT invent extra text
- Do NOT add QR codes, barcodes, logos, icons, or colors

====================================================
6. LABEL DESIGN RULES
====================================================
- The AI is FREE to design the label layout visually
- The design must:
  - Be readable on very small labels
  - Work for both small and large labels
  - Use black and white only
  - Be suitable for laser printing
- Font sizes must scale correctly
- Content must NEVER overflow label boundaries

====================================================
7. APPLICATION FEATURES
====================================================
The web application must support:

- Manual input of label data
- Batch printing from a table/list
- Selection of label type:
  - Tem nhỏ
  - Tem lớn
- Input number of labels to print

-------------------------
LABEL POSITION SELECTION
-------------------------
This feature is REQUIRED.

- Each label position on the sheet has a fixed index number
- Index order:
  - Left to right
  - Top to bottom
- User inputs:
  - Starting label index (Vị trí tem bắt đầu in)

Application behavior:
- Skip all labels before the selected index
- Print only on remaining labels
- Validate remaining empty labels
- Show Vietnamese error message if overflow occurs

====================================================
8. PREVIEW & VALIDATION
====================================================
- Provide a visual preview of the label layout
- Clearly indicate:
  - Labels that will be printed
  - Labels that are skipped
- Validation errors must be shown in Vietnamese

====================================================
9. OUTPUT REQUIREMENTS
====================================================
The AI must generate:
- Complete web app UI (Vietnamese)
- AI-designed label layout
- Accurate PDF generation logic
- PDF file ready for real printing on label sheets

DO NOT:
- Reference any existing label design
- Invent additional requirements
- Change paper size, margins, or grid values

Focus on accuracy, simplicity, and production reliability.
